A great lawn starts here

Lawn care Melbourne homeowners can hand over completely

Most mowing services cut the grass and leave. Our programs look after the whole lawn and garden: feeding, weed and grub control, soil health and pest and disease control, plus the mowing, edging, hedging and pruning that keep it all sharp.

Dan started The Mowersaurus in 2021. He's a qualified horticulturalist who saw a gap for genuinely high-quality, all-inclusive lawn and garden care in Melbourne's north east. The model is simple. Choose the level that matches your expectations (Good, Great or Amazing) and our team takes it from there, visit after visit.

    FAQ

    Lawn care questions, answered

    How much does lawn care cost in Melbourne's north east?

    Every property is quoted on its size, condition and access. As a guide, our indicative pricing for an average 350 m² lawn is around $300–$350 a month on the Good Lawn Program, $375–$425 on the Great Lawn Program and $650–$700 on the Amazing Lawn Program. Request a quote for an exact figure for your place.

    What's the difference between the Good, Great and Amazing lawn programs?

    Each one is an all-inclusive lawn care program. The difference is the result you want. Good keeps a lawn at a healthy, tidy 7/10 on a sensible budget. Great is our specialty, a 9/10 lawn for house-proud homeowners. Amazing is golf-course quality, which we jokingly call a "12 out of 10". The higher the level, the more attention and treatment your lawn gets through the year.

    Do you service Doncaster, Templestowe and Lower Templestowe?

    Yes. Lower Templestowe, Templestowe, Doncaster East and Doncaster are some of our busiest suburbs for lawn care in Melbourne's north east, alongside the rest of Melbourne's north east, from Epping and Mill Park through to Eltham, Diamond Creek and Rosanna. See every suburb on our service areas page.

    When is the best time to renovate a lawn in Melbourne?

    For the warm-season grasses most Melbourne homes have (couch, kikuyu, buffalo and zoysia), the best window is mid-spring into early summer, once the lawn is actively growing and can recover quickly. We don't renovate in winter, when the grass is dormant. Read more about lawn renovation.

    Can I combine a lawn program with a garden maintenance program in Eltham or Greensborough?

    Absolutely, and lots of our clients do. A lawn care program and a garden maintenance program are chosen separately, so you can mix and match levels. A popular combination is the Great Lawn Program with the Good Garden Program. This works anywhere we service, including Eltham and Greensborough.

    Do you look after commercial and body corporate gardens in Doncaster?

    Yes. We're fully insured and maintain commercial, strata and body corporate grounds as well as homes, in Doncaster and right across our service area. Our programs suit commercial sites well because the grounds are looked after on a schedule without anyone needing to chase it.
